target.title: fix(gateway): reset channel restart counter after a stable run
target.body:
## Summary

Channel auto-restart attempts only ever reset on a manual stop/start. The auto-restart path re-enters `startChannelInternal` with `preserveRestartAttempts: true`, so a successful recovery keeps the accumulated count forever. Any channel whose transport blips once a day therefore accumulates one attempt per day and permanently dies with `giving up after 10 restart attempts` about `MAX_RESTART_ATTEMPTS` days after its last manual restart — while being perfectly healthy in between.

Observed live (2026.6.11, Telegram, nightly ~01:10 UTC Bot API restart, gateway with multi-week uptime):

```
Jul 04 01:10:42 [telegram] [default] auto-restart attempt 1/10 in 5s
Jul 05 01:10:42 [telegram] [default] auto-restart attempt 3/10 in 20s
Jul 06 01:10:47 [telegram] [default] auto-restart attempt 4/10 in 40s
Jul 07 01:10:43 [telegram] [default] auto-restart attempt 5/10 in 87s
```

Each blip recovered fine, yet the channel was five days from permanent silent death.

**Fix:** on channel exit, clear the attempt count when the run outlasted `CHANNEL_RESTART_POLICY.maxMs` (5 min) — supervisor-window semantics (systemd `StartLimit*`, Erlang supervisors). Crash-loops (instant exits) still reach the give-up cap exactly as before, and backoff still applies per incident.

**Deliberate trade-off (called out for review):** a channel that consistently runs longer than the max backoff between exits now retries forever instead of permanently giving up. For messaging channels, permanent silent death is the worse failure mode; the give-up cap remains for real crash-loops.

## Verification

- `pnpm test src/gateway/server-channels.test.ts` — 82 passed, including new test `resets the restart counter after a stable run` (two instant exits accumulate attempts 1-2, a stable run exits, next restart is attempt 1 — pre-fix it is 3).
- `pnpm tsgo`, `pnpm check:test-types`, `oxfmt --check`, `scripts/run-oxlint.mjs` clean on both touched files.

Real behavior proof
Behavior addressed: channel auto-restart counter accumulates across isolated recoveries until the channel permanently gives up
Real environment tested: production OpenClaw 2026.6.11 box (Ubuntu, systemd user gateway) for the bug reproduction; Vitest fake-timer harness for the fix
Exact steps or command run after this patch: pnpm test src/gateway/server-channels.test.ts
Evidence after fix: new behavior test passes (reconnectAttempts === 1 after a stable run, was 3); full server-channels suite green
Observed result after fix: stable-run exit resets the counter; crash-loop give-up behavior unchanged ("caps crash-loop restarts after max attempts" still passes)
What was not tested: the patched build was not deployed to the live box; the live reproduction above is from the unpatched 2026.6.11 journal
